I am an old man now, 62 years, and I have been growing maize here in Lilongwe all my life on this small piece of land. This year I am hoping to get a FISP coupon so I can buy NPK and urea at the subsidy price — without that coupon, fertilizer is too expensive for me, but I will plan as if I receive it like most of my neighbors do. I will plant hybrid seed because it gives better yield, and I will intercrop with groundnuts or beans as I always do to help the soil and feed my family. I am too old to work as hard as before, so my wife and children help me, and for weeding and harvest I sometimes ask a neighbor's son for a few days of piecework (ganyu).
